title: A day-2 action waits for a second person's approval of its preview, then replaces its command resource once

steps.label: plywood action previews the replacement of prod-us's rotate command alone, records the request and prints the line that approves it
the reviewer, not the requester, approves the request the preview's digest binds
main keeps the command's marker as the request saw it
the same call after the approval replaces the command once and records how it ended

break.note: After the approval, main changes the command's marker, so the preview the second call makes differs from the one approved: the request waits again (exit 3), nothing is replaced, and the run step's exit 0 and ok outcome must not hold.
